Lina (Events): Heads-up: we're swapping the order — quick wins then roadmap. can presenters adapt? mic check in 4.
presenter-bot: reminder: all-hands starts at 1766299990
Maya (AV): One note — encoder-1 reported a transient reset during rehearsal. switching live to encoder-2 now.
Ravi (Eng): Mirroring encoder -> encoder-2 and repointing ingest. command: `curl -X POST https://ctl.internal/ingest/switch -d '{"to":"encoder-2"}'`
Maya (AV): encoder-2 live, iso recording active. OBS needs a scene refresh in ~6s.
Lina (Events): Great. Chris, Product asked for a 90s slot for a demo. Can we compress the Q&A or extend by 2m?
Chris (Product): We can trim the demo to 3m without the deep-dive. happy to move detailed Qs to the post list.
Eve (CEO): I'll announce the shortened demo and tell folks to drop deep questions in #post-allhands with the prefix "followup:" so we can route.
Maya (AV): Small warning — captions on backup are ~5-8s delayed. flag during intros.
Ravi (Eng): Also seeing a minor hum on channel 4 at -40dB. likely desk fan from presenter laptop. @Lina ask presenter to go headset if possible.
Lina (Events): @Maya can you confirm stream health once we start?
Maya (AV): Will monitor. local preview green, viewers ~stable, bitrate 3.2Mbps.
presenter-bot: recording: encoder-2 iso started at 1766300020
Lina (Events): Mic check — @Eve can you confirm you can hear Alex (presenter) ok?
Eve (CEO): Heard, levels good. No hum.
Ravi (Eng): Snapshot archive scheduled at +90s after stop to avoid dropped tail.
Lina (Events): Thanks — we'll stop recording +90s after applause. For follow-ups: prefix with "followup:" and owner. I'll collect and assign tomorrow by noon.
Maya (AV): OBS reattached, captions flipped to secondary, stream splice looks clean.
Lina (Events): All set — rolling in 30s. good luck everyone. :rocket:
